title: Julie Bale — It's never too late to sing

seo.description: It's never too late to sing. Singing, mentorship and performance with dramatic soprano and Vocal Transformation Specialist Julie Bale.

sections.heading: It's never too late to sing.
sections.intro: Discover the voice, confidence and performer that have been waiting to be heard.

sections.statement: Perhaps you've always wanted to sing.
sections.sub: Perhaps you used to, and life got in the way. Perhaps you sing in a choir but would never dream of standing up alone. Perhaps somebody told you, years ago, that you couldn't. Or perhaps you simply wonder whether it's too late. It isn't.

sections.heading: From First Note to Final Curtain

sections.quote: Julie unlocked something deep within me and lifted my whole world to a new level. Now each morning feels like a song I can sing with confidence.

sections.heading: Other ways to sing with me

items.title: The VIP Diva Day
items.line: A whole day devoted to your voice, with a professional accompanist.

items.title: Diva Days & Open Days
items.line: Come and sing. No need to arrive confident, just willing to join in.

items.title: Retreats
items.line: Singing somewhere beautiful, with time to enjoy being there.

sections.heading: I'm a singer first.
sections.body: I'm Julie Bale, a dramatic soprano and Vocal Transformation Specialist. I've spent my life singing, performing and helping other people discover what their own voice can do. I still perform. I still love it.

sections.heading: Hear me, and hear me sing.
What if you stopped wondering whether you could sing?
Not ready to sing with me yet?
sections.body: Start here. I'm putting together a free first experience to help you find your voice. Join the Diva Energy emails and I'll send it your way.
sections.note: I respect your privacy. No spam, ever.
